column1: # Roots an affix drill CARD may bring in that the audio drill never voices (tunatale-5i1p.6). Hand-written.
# root<TAB>pattern<TAB>the root's English<TAB>the English of each form, in the pattern's order
# The columns of affix_glosses.tsv, and the same rules (tests/test_ceb_affix_chain.py): both forms
# vouched by native news, and no root that is also a gloss row of the same pattern. This file is NOT
# read by affix_patterns.py::pattern_roots, so the audio drill never picks these roots. The card
# takes the first one the learner understands (its recognition card in review) that no listened
# drill of the pattern records, so in steps 2 to 6 it asks for a root the drill never voiced.
# Written 2026-11-13 and checked against John U. Wolff, A Dictionary of Cebuano Visayan (1972;
# Project Gutenberg #40074). NOT checked by a native speaker, like every table in this plugin.
#   gawas [A2] "Migawas siya sa balay, He went out of the house" (news: mo- 587, mi- 665)
#   abot  [A]  "arrive, reach a place" (news: mo- 2644, mi- 1140)
#   balik [A2] "Dì na makabalik sa trabáhu ang nawilgista" (news: maka- 378, naka- 109)
#   uli   [A2; a12] "Dì ta makaulì kay way trák" (news: maka- 169, naka- 121)
#   sakay "Wà ku makasakay dáyun, I couldn't find transportation right away" (news: maka- 76, naka- 75)
